The harness at the pin (eval/agentdojo/run.py, GATE_VERSION = 4) names pipelines '{label}-{mode}-g4' plus '-cap2' for munim and writes a 'ledger_dir' field into results files; no results file has 'ledger_dir', and the directories '-munim', '-none', '-munim-cap2-g2', '-munim-cap2-g3' come from earlier code states (gate v1-v3) that are not in the two-commit history. harness_notes: eval/agentdojo/run.py line 197 at the pin: pipeline.name = label-mode-g<GATE_VERSION> + -cap<cap_multiplier> for munim; cap_multiplier default 2.0 (per-action cap = 2 x the largest amount the account ever sent, daily budget 2 x cap per eval/agentdojo/README.md). So g2/g3/g4 = gate version, cap2 = cap multiplier 2. Our identity table says the repository does not explain these labels

run.py uses AgentDojo's benchmark_suite_with_injections with force_rerun default False, so an existing log for the same pipeline name is reused, not rerun (AgentDojo benchmark.py at v0.1.35: line 101 for attacked pairs, line 268 in run_task_without_injection_tasks for the pre-pass [fact-check precision]). The injection-task pre-pass (9 injection tasks run as user tasks) is therefore written once per pipeline name and shared by its important_instructions and tool_knowledge runs

run.py subclasses AgentDojo's OpenAILLM as SteadyOpenAILLM: sends temperature 0.0 explicitly (the stock wrapper drops it: openai_llm.py v0.1.35 line 162 'temperature or NOT_GIVEN'), and replaces a malformed tool-call argument string by a harness-written assistant turn '[malformed tool call arguments: ...]' and a length-truncated reply without tool calls by '[response truncated at the output limit]'

run.py sets MODEL_NAMES.setdefault(label, --model-family) with default family 'GLM'; AgentDojo's get_model_name_from_pipeline matches by substring of the pipeline name, so the attack text addresses gpt-oss-120b as 'GLM' unless --model-family was passed (not recorded)
suite = get_suite('v1', 'banking'); benchmark_version not passed, hence null in every log (D-102)

munim_defense.py GatedToolsExecutor: a hold or deny returns a tool message whose error starts 'Declined by the account's money gate. ' followed by the decision summary and, at the pin, an instruction not to retry; it also emits 'Empty function name provided...' and 'Invalid tool ... provided.' errors (the census found 180 tool errors in all = 180 denials, so none of these)
Gate statistics in results files: gate_stats = pair episodes only (pre-pass episodes excluded, counted from the ledger), gate_stats_all_episodes = every episode of the run including the pre-pass

Installation not declared (pyproject declares no dependency; README asks for a venv with agentdojo, openai, mcp, httpx). Suite v1 banking; attacks important_instructions and tool_knowledge; defence = Munim GatedToolsExecutor replacing ToolsExecutor (baselines use AgentDojo's ToolsExecutor). Provider: Fireworks OpenAI-compatible endpoint (run.py DEFAULT_BASE_URL). Known AgentDojo issues relevant to banking: #181 banking injection tasks 0/1/3 subject check is dead code (operator precedence), so security = any transaction to the attacker's IBAN (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/181, open); #67 the injection replaces the original bill content (user_task_0) (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/67, closed) - matches the repository's statement that user_task_0 fails under attack in every arm; #194 banking update_scheduled_transaction cannot set falsy values (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/194, open); #208 replaying ground truth / scoring stopped attacks (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/208, open); #214 non-ASCII tool results as \uXXXX (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/214, open); #212 --max-workers > 1 crash (not used here). Temperature-dropping in the stock OpenAILLM: https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/blob/v0.1.35/src/agentdojo/agent_pipeline/llms/openai_llm.py
